versions.subject: Add files via upload
versions.detection:
selection:
    uri_query|contains:
        - '*cmd=read*'
        - '*connect&target*'
        - '*cmd=connect*'
        - '*cmd=disconnect*'
        - '*&port*'
        - '*cmd=forward*'
filter:
    referer: null
    useragent: null
    method: POST
condition: selection and filter
versions.spl: uri_query IN ("*cmd=read*", "*connect&target*", "*cmd=connect*", "*cmd=disconnect*", "*&port*", "*cmd=forward*") NOT referer=* NOT useragent=* method="POST"
